summary: Implemented a frontend localStorage-backed owner contact utility and hook, and updated header/footer to generate WhatsApp links from stored values. However, the diff evidence is insufficient to confirm the new Owner Dashboard UI section for editing contact details, and the Home page email mailto/omission behavior is not clearly evidenced in the truncated diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an Owner Dashboard section that allows the owner to view and update the contact email and WhatsApp number, gated by the existing Owner Mode flow.
missing_requirements.reason: OwnerPage.tsx shows new imports for contact utilities/validation, but the diff content is truncated before any tab/section UI, form fields, save handler, or success feedback can be verified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Home page Contact section displays the owner email as a clickable mailto: link when an email is set; if not set, it omits the email line (no placeholder text).
missing_requirements.reason: HomePage.tsx is truncated before the Contact section; while it imports/useOwnerContact (email) there is no visible evidence of a mailto: link or conditional omission behavior.

hallucinated_features.description: Ability to clear owner contact details from localStorage via a dedicated clearOwnerContact() API.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only asks to get/set and persist contact details with defaults; it does not request a clear/reset function.

hallucinated_features.description: Custom cross-component update mechanism using a window 'ownerContactUpdated' CustomEvent and a dedicated useOwnerContact hook that listens to that event (and storage events).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest asks for a single source of truth utility and using saved values across the site, but does not explicitly request a custom event + hook-based reactive update system.
